faq.label: FREQUENTLY ASKED QUESTIONS
faq.support: A few things clients usually want to know.

items.question: What kind of companies do you work with?
items.answer: We work with ambitious companies, institutions and brands that value strategic thinking, strong creative systems and measurable execution.

items.question: Do you work on strategy only?
items.answer: Yes. Strategy can be a standalone engagement when clarity and direction are the priority.

items.question: Can Global Comm handle execution as well?
items.answer: Yes. Branding, content, digital marketing, web and automation can be coordinated under the same strategic direction.

items.question: How does a project usually start?
items.answer: With a discovery conversation that establishes context, objectives, constraints and the right next step.

items.question: Do you offer ongoing engagements?
items.answer: Yes. Ongoing engagements are structured around a clear scope, cadence, responsibilities and reporting rhythm.
